summary: POST_SHOCK_ACTIONABILITY_CAPABILITY_REQUIRED. The frozen stack correctly separates shock-day evidence, diagnostic sealing, the delayed t0-to-h24 discovery label and terminal Manager review, but it does not yet bind a causal strategy decision or fill. The terminal post-shock result has discovery disposition, episode, breadth and statistics fields but lacks manager_reviewed_at, decision_available_at, a separately sourced next feasible fill, parent identity and complete economic-ledger fields. No approved adapter binds the post-shock mechanism and actionability record; dra-forward-entry-admission-v1 is explicitly frozen to the distinct DRA volume/range mechanism. A daily parent cannot claim the t0-to-h24 response when its next valid decision occurs after that window, while a generic later hourly route remains unproven rather than inherently impossible. One parent-neutral pre-outcome actionability contract/validator slice can finitely bind availability and point-in-time fill evidence before any separately frozen adapter is considered. Discovery episodes remain excluded from future OOS. Immediate fee-adjusted PnL and drawdown effects are zero; actionability and all economic value remain MISSING_PROOF.

checks.name: EVENT_RECEIPT_DIAGNOSTIC_CLOCK_TRACE
checks.evidence: For shock day D, the diagnostic binds target_day.received_at and requires diagnostic sealed_at no earlier than that receipt. The post-shock episode defines t0 as D+1 00:00:00Z, consumes exactly [t0,t0+24h), requires outcome received_at strictly after diagnostic sealing, and requires episode sealed_at no earlier than outcome receipt. A terminal snapshot is then sealed and its Coach event is queued by the same heartbeat after shock processing.

checks.name: MANAGER_REVIEW_CLOCK_BINDING
checks.evidence: Heartbeat delivery state can bind event queued_at and receipt acknowledged_at, but the terminal factor result does not bind a semantic manager_reviewed_at or an accepted interpretation receipt. Therefore Manager review cannot currently serve as a hash-bound strategy decision boundary.

checks.name: EARLIEST_CAUSAL_DECISION_AND_FILL_RULE
checks.evidence: A lawful future decision_available_at must equal the maximum of the actionability-contract activation, terminal Manager review, target evidence received_at and shock diagnostic sealed_at. Any fill must be strictly later and bind a separately frozen point-in-time price source and observation; neither nominal t0 nor the diagnostic h1/h6/h24 close may be substituted.

checks.name: CURRENT_DECISION_AND_FILL_BINDING
checks.evidence: The current shock diagnostic and terminal factor schemas contain no decision_available_at, next_feasible_fill_at, fill price, price-source contract hash or point-in-time observation hash. The discovery response therefore cannot be represented as executable strategy economics.

checks.name: TERMINAL_RESULT_ACTIONABILITY_MATRIX
checks.evidence: Present fields include terminal/disposition, sealed_at, latest outcome and cumulative-chain bindings, episodes with t0 and source receipts, fixed h1/h6/h24 responses, breadth gates, statistics and zero-action guardrails. Missing fields are Manager review, decision availability, next feasible fill, price source, parent identity, capital, fee, adverse slippage, valuation boundary, realized/unrealized/total PnL, drawdown, utilization, blocked entries, holding ages and terminal inventory.

checks.name: APPROVED_ADAPTER_COMPATIBILITY
checks.evidence: The approved inventory contains seven adapters. None explicitly binds the BTC 3 percent post-shock mechanism, event clock or actionability record. dra-forward-entry-admission-v1 is the only forward-candidate-eligible adapter, but its immutable identity is DRA V1 volume/range entry admission with one primary ratio and two neighbors; relabelling it as post-shock is forbidden.

checks.name: DRA_DAILY_PARENT_COMPATIBILITY
checks.evidence: The listed DRA forward adapter has no post-shock binding or actionability record. Under the frozen rule, a daily parent's next decision after the completed t0-to-h24 label cannot claim that response as executable PnL. The mismatch cannot be repaired by shifting h24 or reusing the discovery label.

checks.name: GENERIC_HOURLY_SPOT_FEASIBILITY

checks.evidence: The single bounded slice should define a closed parent-neutral actionability document containing: exact terminal-result path/hash/type/disposition/sealed_at/latest-outcome/chain bindings; Manager review id, reviewed_at and result hash; contract activated_at and untouched future evidence_start; future shock diagnostic path/hash, t0, target received_at and diagnostic sealed_at; derived decision_available_at; and a separate fill observation with source-contract hash, artifact hash, observed_at, received_at, fill_at and decimal price. Predictive edge, actionability latency, fees, slippage, capacity, matched-capital PnL, realized/unrealized totals, drawdown, utilization, holding age, terminal inventory, candidate readiness, OOS and activation remain unproven.
